pages.title: How to Tame
pages.text: Every wild animal starts with hunger between 50% and 80% of its max. This means they are always willing to eat.$(br2)Hold the right food and right-click the animal. Its hunger rises, and it becomes $(bold)domesticated$() forever.

pages.title: What to Feed
pages.text: Different animals eat different foods. Check the $(l:animalflee:diet/diet_overview)Diet$() category to learn what each animal prefers. Feeding the wrong food simply won't work.
Pigs are omnivores. They will eat almost anything, including crops and even meat!
